resxGuard.config.keyNaming: How resource keys are suggested from the neutral value (.resx PascalCase / JSON camelCase leaf)
resxGuard.config.updateDesignerCs: Automatically update Resources.Designer.cs when keys change
resxGuard.config.namingSuggestions: Show an Apply action in the grid when a key does not match the naming style for its file type. Independent of the naming validation rule.
resxGuard.config.visibleLocales: Locales shown as grid columns (empty = all)
resxGuard.config.rules.keyPascalCase: Warn when a key does not match naming from the neutral English value (.resx PascalCase / JSON camelCase leaf)
resxGuard.config.rules.matchingSuffix: Warn when translations do not end like the neutral string
resxGuard.config.rules.placeholders: Warn when {0}/{name} placeholders differ from neutral
resxGuard.config.rules.missingTranslatio: Warn when a translation is missing for a locale
resxGuard.config.rules.duplicateKeys: Error when duplicate keys exist in the same file
